entities.name: Rana Mohammad Hanif Khan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rana Mohammad Hanif Khan was a politician who served as the Finance minister of pakistan from 22 October 1974 to 28 March 1977. He was from Sahiwal, Punjab, Pakistan. He was the elder son of Ch. Nawab khan who migrated from India.
